catalog.title: Seiko Brochure
catalog.edition: export edition (USA, Seiko Time Corporation, New York)
catalog.note: Dealer-recruitment brochure of Seiko Time Corporation, 640 Fifth Avenue, New York ('It's not just a watch.... It's a Seiko — The New Breed of Timepiece!'), 12 scan pages: the company story and six numbered sales points (Modern Manufacture, Product, Sales Turnover, Servicing, Sales Aids, Advertising). It is not a model catalogue: it prints no stock numbers, case-movement (CCCC-NNNN) refs, calibers, jewel counts, bracelet codes or prices for any watch. The only watch photos with records are the four uncaptioned illustrations on scan 2 (two men's, two ladies'), recorded with blank ref/code/price and conf low; dial colour and features come from the photos. The cover hero watch (a square-case automatic, dial 'SEIKO DX AUTOMATIC 17 JEWELS') is a cover image and, like the back-cover logo strip of small watch drawings, is not recorded. Dating: the text says Seiko is 'in its 88th consecutive year' since 1881 and first came to the US 'about five years ago', which fits 1969.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders, Oct 2026, verified against caption crops.
